issues.title: Sitemap advertises conventional MVC URLs that 404
issues.description: SiteMapService builds category URLs via GetDetailPageUrl after ConfigureAwait(false), so HttpContext is often null. BuildDetailRelativePathWithoutHttpContext has no mappings for ProductCategories/Category or Stories/Categories, so sitemap emits /productcategories/category/{slug} and /stories/categories/{slug} instead of canonical /c/pc/{slug}/ and /s/sc/{slug}/. 71 of 300 sitemap loc entries return HTTP 404. Canonical equivalents return 200. Search engines will index dead URLs.
stepsToReproduce: Open a product-category loc such as http://localhost:81/productcategories/category/elektronik-7e7e4h1b
issues.expected: Sitemap loc values are live canonical SEO routes (/c/pc/, /p/, /s/sc/, /s/, /i/).
issues.suggestedFix: In EntityExtension.BuildDetailRelativePathWithoutHttpContext add: ProductCategories/Category → /c/pc/{seoId}, Stories/Categories → /s/sc/{seoId}, Products/Tag → /p/t/{seoId}, Stories/Tag → /s/t/{seoId}. Prefer Url.Action with attribute routes when HttpContext exists. After deploy, clear output cache and regenerate sitemap.

issues.title: Legacy MVC category URLs 404 instead of 301 to /c/pc/
issues.description: ProductCategoriesController.Category is attribute-routed at /c/pc/{id}. Conventional /productcategories/category/{id} is not registered and has no legacy redirect (unlike /c/{slug} CategoryLegacy and /s/categories/{id} StoriesCategoriesLegacy).
issues.suggestedFix: Add a conventional or attribute legacy action that 301s /productcategories/category/{id} → /c/pc/{id}/, and /stories/categories/{id} → /s/sc/{id}/ if not already covered by StorycategoriesLegacy.

issues.title: Site logo returns HTTP 404 on every storefront page
issues.description: Header uses . ImagesController.Logo looks up Settings.WebSiteLogo (value logo-11212_1856486114.png) under ~/media/images/. That file does not exist on disk. The action returns 404 with no fallback default image, so the header shows a broken image on desktop and mobile.
stepsToReproduce: Open http://localhost:81/ and inspect the header logo
issues.expected: JPEG 200 of the configured logo, or a bundled default logo
issues.screenshotOrLog: Playwright MCP home-desktop.png / home-mobile.png (broken header image)
issues.suggestedFix: Re-upload the logo in Admin Settings (WebSiteLogo) so the file exists under media/images. In ImagesController.Logo, if the setting/file is missing, serve a default Content image instead of 404. Do not OutputCache a 404 (already NoCache on miss).

issues.title: Product Summary, Price Analysis, and Product Inventory reports return HTTP 500
issues.description: GET /admin/report/productsummary/, /priceanalysis/, and /productinventory/ all return IIS 500.0. ReportService passes optional null filters through DatabaseUtility.GetSqlParameter, which sets SqlParameter.Value = value without converting null to DBNull.Value. ADO.NET then fails when executing GetProductSummaryReport / GetPriceAnalysisReport / GetProductInventoryReport. The same SPs succeed in SSMS with NULL parameters. ProductInventory CSV export also 500s.
issues.expected: Report HTML 200 (empty-state or data) and CSV download
issues.actual: HTTP 500.0 Internal Server Error on all three pages and ProductInventory export
issues.suggestedFix: In DatabaseUtility.GetSqlParameter, use t.Value = value ?? DBNull.Value. Prefix ProductInventory params with @ (SP expects @State, @IsCampaign, @MainPage). Use SqlDbType.Money for GetPriceAnalysisReport @MinPrice/@MaxPrice. Catch should return a friendly empty report view, not a raw 500.

issues.title: FinancialReport CSV export returns HTTP 500
issues.description: sp_GetFinancialReport succeeds in SQL for 2026-01-01..2026-12-31 (returns data). The MVC export endpoint still returns 500, so the failure is in DownloadReportCsv/DownloadReportExcel after LoadReportDataForExportAsync (likely DataSet multi-table handling or ExcelHelper). The same URL with Turkish dates (01.01.2026) returns 400 (model binder does not parse dd.MM.yyyy into ReportExportFilter.StartDate/EndDate).
stepsToReproduce: GET the same URL with startDate=01.01.2026&endDate=31.12.2026
issues.expected: CSV 200 download; date query-string should accept the format the UI posts
issues.actual: ISO dates → HTTP 500; TR dates → HTTP 400 missing filters
issues.suggestedFix: Fix DataSet→CSV export (null TableName, multiple result sets, DataTable.Load vs NextResult). Bind ReportExportFilter dates with a culture-invariant parser (yyyy-MM-dd) matching _ReportExportButtons. Do not 500 on export exceptions; return 400 with the exception logged.

issues.title: Iyzico checkout cannot complete because API keys are empty
issues.description: IIS web.config has PaymentProvider=Iyzico, IyzicoBaseUrl=sandbox, but IyzicoApiKey and IyzicoSecretKey are empty. Guest add-to-cart → register → billing → PlaceOrder succeeds without exception, then the page shows the empty-form warning instead of the sandbox iframe. Orders cannot be paid on this environment.
stepsToReproduce: Proceed to checkout, register, fill billing, reach PlaceOrder
issues.expected: Iyzico sandbox checkout form (iframe) when PaymentProvider=Iyzico
issues.actual: PlaceOrder renders without iframe: 'iyzico form empty — set IyzicoApiKey/IyzicoSecretKey (sandbox) on IIS'
issues.suggestedFix: Set sandbox IyzicoApiKey/IyzicoSecretKey in IIS (or env vars). Keep the blocking warning, but also surface it in Admin Dashboard when keys are empty so operators do not discover this only at PlaceOrder.

issues.title: Homepage featured products are out of stock (no Add to Cart)
issues.description: Home hero/featured SKUs such as Nordline Wireless Bluetooth Kulaklık Pro are shown with price but ProductState is not ProductInStock. Product detail shows 'Ürün Stokta Yok' and omits #AddToCart. Only 15 of ~150 products are ProductInStock; many listing/home cards still promote AwaitingRestock/OutOfStock items. Guests cannot start checkout from the primary merchandising surface. A previously used SEO URL /p/ayakkabi/fitlife-unisex-kosu-ayakkabisi-airflex-9a6g9a5i4h1b/ now 404s.
stepsToReproduce: Click a featured product (e.g. Nordline Wireless Bluetooth Kulaklık Pro)
issues.expected: Featured/home products are buyable, or OOS items are labeled and excluded from 'add to cart' carousels
issues.actual: Detail page: 'Ürün Stokta Yok', no #AddToCart. In-stock SKUs (State=ProductInStock) still add to cart correctly when opened directly.
issues.suggestedFix: Filter home/main-page product queries to ProductState.ProductInStock (IsBuyableState). Show an OOS badge on cards instead of a buy CTA. Fix or 301 stale product SEO URLs still linked from tests/emails.

issues.title: Header phone link is an invalid tel: URI
issues.description: _WebSiteAddressInfo.cshtml sets href='tel:{WebSiteCompanyPhoneAndLocation}'. The setting value is a combined string like '+90 216 555 01 23 | İstanbul', producing tel:+90 216 555 01 23 | İstanbul which mobile dialers reject.
issues.suggestedFix: Store phone and location separately, or strip non-dialable characters when building the tel: href. Keep the display text as-is.

issues.title: Duplicate X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN response header
issues.description: Every response sends X-Frame-Options twice. web.config customHeaders adds it, and SecurityHeadersHttpModule.OnPreSendRequestHeaders sets it again. Duplicate security headers can confuse proxies and fail some security scanners.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the header from web.config customHeaders and keep SecurityHeadersHttpModule (or vice versa). In the module, Remove then Add to avoid duplicates.

issues.title: NLog file target writes nothing; AppLogs table is synthetic seed data
issues.description: NLog.config fileName is ${basedir}/media/logs/EImeceLog.log but media/logs contains only Web.config (no .log/.json). The AppLogs SQL table has exactly 20 rows of each of 5 repeating messages (Fatal payment timeout, Error payment validation, Warn slow ProductRepository, Info login, Debug cache) at 1-minute offsets — not traces from this QA run. Report 500s and logo 404s did not appear as new ERROR rows, so operators cannot debug from Admin AppLogs.
issues.expected: EImeceLog.log/json updated; AppLogs shows the real exception
issues.actual: No log files. AppLogs still only the 100 seed rows.
issues.suggestedFix: Grant the IIS app-pool identity Modify on media/logs. Confirm ${basedir} is the site root. Enable NLog internalLogFile temporarily. Ensure minLevel includes Error for the database target. Stop or flag demo seed rows in AppLogs.

issues.title: Mobile menu toggle is a non-accessible empty div
issues.description:
Crizal _Header.cshtml renders
with no role=button, aria-label, tabindex, or keyboard handler. Click/tap does open #nav (theme.js + nav-menu.js), so this is not a functional mobile-nav failure, but keyboard and screen-reader users cannot operate the menu. Contrast: the control is a 44×44 div, not a button.
stepsToReproduce: Tab through the header — hamburger is skipped
issues.actual: Empty div; menu only via pointer click
issues.suggestedFix: Change the toggler to a <button type="button"> with aria-label/aria-expanded/aria-controls. Keep existing .navbar-toggler CSS/JS hooks.

issues.title: Image resize URLs use a zero dimension (w0h500 / w610h0)
issues.description: Info and product gallery src values include /images/w0h500/... and /images/w610h0/.... Those requests currently return 200 JPEG, but a 0 width/height is an invalid crop size and can break the ImagesController resize math or produce oddly sized images after a cache/code change.
stepsToReproduce: Open a product gallery image such as /images/w610h0/nordline-wireless-bluetooth-kulaklik-pro-1b8c8c5i1b.jpg/
issues.expected: Resize URLs always have positive width and height (e.g. w420h280)
issues.actual: w0h500 on about/delivery; w610h0 on product gallery
issues.suggestedFix: In GetCroppedImageUrl / image-size helpers, coerce 0 to the configured default width/height before building /images/w{W}h{H}/ paths.
